name: dsh-docker-services
description: Guarded Docker operations for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/controller/lib/test/*.test.js packages/proxy/lib/test/*.test.js packages/plugin/lib/test/*.test.js
scripts.pack:all: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true})" && npm pack --workspace @dsh-docker-services/shared --pack-destination artifacts && npm pack --workspace @dsh-docker-services/controller --pack-destination artifacts && npm pack --workspace @dsh-docker-services/proxy --pack-destination artifacts && npm pack --workspace dsh-docker-services --pack-destination artifacts
scripts.ci: npm run verify:lock && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run pack:all && npm run verify:package && npm run test:consumer
